descriptionChirho: A ring worn in or on the nose as personal adornment, often given as a gift or part of bridal jewelry (Gen 24:47; Isa 3:21; Prov 11:22).
A ring worn on the ear as jewelry or ornament, sometimes associated with foreign or idolatrous practices (Gen 35:4; Exod 32:2-3; Judg 8:24-26; Ezek 16:12).
A ring used as personal adornment where the specific placement (nose or ear) is unspecified or contextually ambiguous (Gen 24:22; Hos 2:15).
